title: An Act establishing reliance on written representations by retirement boards concerning the purchase or establishment of creditable service

abstracts.abstract: By Mr. Brownsberger (by request), a petition (accompanied by bill) (subject to Joint Rule 12) of Noelle Costa for legislation to establish reliance on written representations by retirement boards concerning the purchase or establishment of creditable service.  Public Service.
